#import data
```{r}
parcels.path = file.path(resultdata, '00_Harmonisation', '00c_parcels', '00c_parcels.gpkg')
parcels <- st_read(parcels.path)
parcels <- st_transform(parcels, CRS)

buildings.path = file.path(resultdata, '00_Harmonisation', '00b_02_buildings', '00b_02_buildings.gpkg')
buildings <- st_read(buildings.path)
buildings <- st_transform(buildings, CRS)

streets.path = file.path(resultdata, '00_Harmonisation', '00d_streets', '00d_streetriver.gpkg')
streets <- st_read(streets.path)
streets <- st_transform(streets, CRS)

corine.path <- file.path(resultdata, '00_Harmonisation', '00e_corine', '00e_corine.gpkg')
corine <- st_read(corine.path)
corine <- st_transform(corine, CRS)
```
#data prep corine
```{r}
# crop by parcel
#parcel_buffer <- st_buffer(st_union(parcels), dist = 200)
#corine <- st_zm(corine, drop = TRUE, what = "ZM")
#parcel_buffer <- st_zm(parcel_buffer, drop = TRUE, what = "ZM")
#corine <- st_intersection(corine, parcel_buffer) 

# group corine into urban and non urban groups
corine <- corine %>%
  mutate(
    landclass = case_when(
      Code_18 >= 111 & Code_18 <= 142 ~ "urban",
      TRUE ~ "non urban"
    )
  )
corine <- st_zm(corine)
corine <- corine %>%
  group_by(landclass) %>%
  summarise(.groups = "drop")
corine <- st_make_valid(corine)


# crop by AGS_INSEE in parcels and intersect with Corine
parcels.agsinsee <- parcels %>%
  group_by(AGS_INSEE) %>%
  summarise(.groups = "drop")
parcels.agsinsee <- st_make_valid(parcels.agsinsee)

# assign AGS_INSEE to corine
corine.intersected <- st_intersection(corine, parcels.agsinsee)

rm(corine, parcels.agsinsee)
gc()

corine.intersected <- corine.intersected %>%
  filter(landclass == "urban") %>%
  select(AGS_INSEE, geom, landclass)
```
#overlap analysis parcels buildings and join street names
```{r}
intersections <- st_intersection(parcels, buildings %>% filter(area > 20))

intersections$area_overlap <- st_area(intersections)

# Keep parcel_id and street
intersections <- intersections %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(parcel_id, street, area_overlap)

# Optionally: pick the **first street** per parcel (or you can use a better rule)
intersections <- intersections %>%
  group_by(parcel_id) %>%
  summarise(
    total_overlap = sum(area_overlap),
    street = first(street)  # or use a majority vote / concatenate
  )

parcels.buildingpc <- left_join(parcels, intersections, by = "parcel_id")

rm(intersections)
gc()

parcels.buildingpc$parcel_area <- st_area(parcels.buildingpc)
parcels.buildingpc <- st_drop_geometry(parcels.buildingpc)
parcels.buildingpc$building_pc <- (parcels.buildingpc$total_overlap / parcels.buildingpc$parcel_area)
parcels.buildingpc$building_pc[is.na(parcels.buildingpc$building_pc)] <- 0
```
#assign dominant corine to parcel
```{r message=FALSE}
# currently: run in QGIS

ags_list <- intersect(unique(parcels$AGS_INSEE), unique(corine.intersected$AGS_INSEE))

# Initialize list to store results
dominant_results <- list()

# Loop through AGS_INSEE values
for (ags in ags_list) {
  # Filter to current municipality
  p_sub <- parcels %>% filter(AGS_INSEE == ags)
  c_sub <- corine.intersected %>% filter(AGS_INSEE == ags)

  # Skip if either is empty
  if (nrow(p_sub) == 0 || nrow(c_sub) == 0) next

  # Intersect and calculate overlap
  p_c <- st_intersection(p_sub, c_sub)
  p_c$overlap_area <- st_area(p_c)

p_c <- st_drop_geometry(p_c)
p_c <- p_c %>%
  group_by(parcel_id) %>%
  summarise(
    urban_area = sum(overlap_area),
    area = first(area)
  )

p_c <- p_c %>%
  mutate(urban_pc = as.numeric(urban_area) / as.numeric(area))
p_c <- p_c %>%
  select(parcel_id, urban_pc)
  
  # Store result
  dominant_results[[ags]] <- p_c
}

results <- bind_rows(dominant_results)

parcels.urbanpc <- parcels %>%
  left_join(results, by = "parcel_id")

rm(results)  # from dominant_results loop
gc()

parcels.urbanpc <- parcels.urbanpc %>%
  mutate(urban_pc = replace_na(urban_pc, 0))
```
#join urbanpc and buildingpc and filter
```{r}
parcels.joinedurbanbuildingpc <- left_join(
  parcels.urbanpc,
  parcels.buildingpc %>% select(parcel_id, building_pc, parcel_area, building_area = total_overlap, street),
  by = "parcel_id"
)

rm(parcels.urbanpc, parcels.buildingpc)
gc()

parcels.joinedurbanbuildingpc <- parcels.joinedurbanbuildingpc %>%
  filter(
    !(as.numeric(urban_pc) == 0 & as.numeric(building_pc) == 0) &
    !(as.numeric(building_pc) < 0.05 & as.numeric(urban_pc) < 0.1)&
    !(as.numeric(building_pc) == 0 & as.numeric(urban_pc) < 0.4)
  )
```

#buffer streets and overlap with parcels
```{r}
# Initialize result list
dominant_results <- list()

# Get unique AGS_INSEE codes
ags_list <- unique(parcels.joinedurbanbuildingpc$AGS_INSEE)

# Loop through each AGS_INSEE code
for (ags in ags_list) {
  
  # Filter streets and parcels by AGS_INSEE
  streets_group <- streets %>% filter(AGS_INSEE == ags)
parcels_group <- parcels.joinedurbanbuildingpc %>%
  filter(AGS_INSEE == ags) %>%
  select(parcel_id, AGS_INSEE, parcel_area)
  
  # Skip if group is empty or has too few features
  if (nrow(streets_group) == 0 || nrow(parcels_group) == 0) next
  
  # Process
  df <- streets_group %>%
    st_buffer(dist = 3) %>%
    st_union() %>%
    st_sf()

  intersections <- st_intersection(parcels_group, df)
  intersections$area_overlap <- st_area(intersections)

  intersections <- intersections %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    group_by(parcel_id) %>%
    summarise(total_overlap = sum(area_overlap), .groups = "drop")

  # Drop geometry from parcels to speed up
  parcels_group <- parcels_group %>% st_drop_geometry()

  p_c <- left_join(parcels_group, intersections, by = "parcel_id") %>%
    mutate(
      street_pc = as.numeric(total_overlap) / parcel_area,
      street_pc = ifelse(is.na(street_pc), 0, street_pc)
    )

  # Save result in list
  dominant_results[[ags]] <- p_c
}

# Combine all results into a single data frame
results <- bind_rows(dominant_results)

parcels.streetpc <- parcels.joinedurbanbuildingpc %>%
  left_join(
    results %>% select(parcel_id, street_pc),
    by = "parcel_id"
  )

rm(parcels.joinedurbanbuildingpc, results)
gc()

parcels.streetpc <- parcels.streetpc %>%
  filter(
   !(as.numeric(building_pc) < 0.05 & as.numeric(street_pc) > 0.2)    
)
```

#filter out extremely narrow parcels 
```{r}
parcels.streetpc <- parcels.streetpc %>%
  mutate(
    shape_index = as.numeric(parcel_area) / as.numeric(perimeter^2)
  ) %>%
 filter(shape_index > 0.005)
parcels.streetpc <- parcels.streetpc %>% select(-shape_index)
```

#collapse building islands, exclude unbuilt ones
```{r}
parcels_dissolved <- parcels.streetpc %>%
  st_union()

# Cast back to single parts (split disconnected geometries)
parcels_singleparts <- st_cast(parcels_dissolved, "POLYGON")

# Turn into an sf object and assign island IDs
parcels_islands <- st_sf(
  island_id = seq_len(length(parcels_singleparts)),
  geometry = parcels_singleparts
)

intersection_list <- st_intersects(parcels.streetpc, parcels_islands)

parcels.island_id <- parcels.streetpc %>%
  mutate(island_id = map_int(intersection_list, ~ if(length(.x) > 0) parcels_islands$island_id[.x[1]]))


island_building_summary <- parcels.island_id %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  group_by(island_id) %>%
  summarise(total_building_area = sum(building_area, na.rm = TRUE)) 

island_building_summary <- island_building_summary %>%
  filter(as.numeric(total_building_area) >= 40)

# Filter original parcels by these island IDs
parcels.island_id <- parcels.island_id %>%
  filter(island_id %in% island_building_summary$island_id)

#add function to split into DE and FR

outputDE.path <- file.path(
  resultdata,
  child_env$subdir,
  "02c_01_DevelopmentBlockIdentificationDE.gpkg")

outputFR.path <- file.path(
  resultdata,
  child_env$subdir,
  "02c_01_DevelopmentBlockIdentificationFR.gpkg")

parcels.DE <- parcels.island_id %>%
  filter(country == de)
parcels.FR<- parcels.island_id %>%
  filter(country == fr)

st_write(parcels.DE, outputDE.path)
st_write(parcels.FR, outputFR.path)
```
